headline_marked: [[Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir to be sworn in as 23rd President]] of Bangladesh today
headline: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir to be sworn in as 23rd President of Bangladesh today
summary: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir will take his oath as the 23rd President of Bangladesh today at Bangabhaban, with the acting Speaker administering the ceremony.
details: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is set to be sworn in as the 23rd President of the People's Republic of Bangladesh today. The oath-taking ceremony will officially commence at 7 PM on Friday, August 21, in the Darbar Hall of Bangabhaban.

Barrister Kaiser Kamal, the acting Speaker of the Jatiya Sangsad, will administer the oath to the newly elected President. The state ceremony will be attended by the outgoing President, Prime Minister, Speaker, Chief Justice, cabinet members, chiefs of the three armed forces, diplomats, and other distinguished national and international personalities.

The presidential election took place on Thursday, August 20, at the Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban. Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, nominated by BNP, secured a landslide victory with 255 direct votes from Members of Parliament. His opponent, Colonel (Retd.) Oli Ahmad, chairman of the 11-party alliance's Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), received 88 votes.

Following the vote count, Chief Election Officer and Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) A.M.M. Nasir Uddin officially declared Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as the victorious candidate for the presidential post. Subsequently, a government gazette confirming his election was issued, signed by Akhtar Ahmed, Senior Secretary of the Election Commission.

headline_marked: [[Bangladeshi Hafez Noor]] wins top prize at int'l Quran competition in Saudi Arabia
headline: Bangladeshi Hafez Noor wins top prize at int'l Quran competition in Saudi Arabia
summary: Hafez Noor Uddin Zakaria from Patuakhali's Bauphal secured first place in the 46th King Abdul Aziz International Quran Hifz, Tilawat, and Tafsir Competition in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, beating hundreds of competitors from 133 countries.
details: Hafez Noor Uddin Zakaria from Dhulia Chadkathi, Bauphal, Patuakhali, achieved first place in the 46th King Abdul Aziz International Quran Hifz, Tilawat, and Tafsir Competition held in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The results were announced on Wednesday, August 19.

Hafez Noor surpassed hundreds of competitors from 133 countries to secure the top position in the competition's fourth branch. He is the son of Maulana Nurul Amin and Yanur Begum from Chadkathi village.
Zakaria began his journey at six years old, moving to Dhaka with his uncle, Hafez Qari Mohammad Rahmat Ullah. He completed his Hifz of the Holy Quran at a madrasa in the capital.
Later, he enrolled in Ar Rayhan International Madrasa in Demra. He was studying there when he participated in the international Quran competition in Saudi Arabia.

Dr. Shafiqul Islam Masud, MP for Patuakhali-2 (Bauphal) constituency, local BNP leaders, and the Upazila administration have extended their congratulations to Hafez Noor Uddin Zakaria. His remarkable achievement has been widely celebrated.

His family, relatives, and local residents are overjoyed by Zakaria's international achievement. Locals believe his success on the world stage is a source of pride for Bauphal and an inspiration for the country's youth.
